title.narrative: Covering the needs of the Egyptian Red Crescent

description.narrative: Covering the needs of the Egyptian Red Crescent in establishing warehouses. Covering blood donation and medical equipment needs. Covering digital services that contribute to raising the Society’s capabilities in providing information and data that serve humanitarian work.
Providing support for safe access and delivery of aid to the King Salman Center for Relief and Humanitarian Works for affected families in the Gaza Strip.

Supporting the Egyptian Red Crescent in light of the reality and challenges facing the association in delivering Saudi aid to the Gaza Strip. The Center’s contribution to covering logistical work directly related to the delivery of Saudi aid.
